name: DeKalb County Fire Rescue Explorer Post 901
what_you_do: Train like a firefighter: hose lines, ladders, breathing gear and tools, plus CPR and first aid, fitness and teamwork. After cadet training you may ride along on fire trucks.
who_can_apply: DeKalb County youth ages 14 to 18 who are in school. You keep at least a C average and have good attendance and behavior.
pay_detail: $50 yearly fee, due after you are fully admitted. Not a paid job.
duration: Year-round, with a 2-week summer Cadet Training
deadline_text: No deadline is listed. Meeting times are not listed.
how_to_apply: Get the DCFR Explorer application packet from the page. Send it in with 3 job references and your latest report card.
notes: Contact frexplorers@dekalbcountyga.gov. Not a paid job, so no work permit.
